class Money
  include Comparable

  attr_reader :cents, :currency

  def initialize(cents, currency = "USD")
    @cents = cents
    @currency = currency.dup.freeze
    freeze
  end

  def <=>(other)
    return nil unless other.is_a?(Money) && currency == other.currency

    cents <=> other.cents
  end

  alias eql? ==

  def hash
    [cents, currency].hash
  end

  def to_s
    whole, fraction = cents.abs.divmod(100)
    sign = cents.negative? ? "-" : ""
    format("%s %s%d.%02d", currency, sign, whole, fraction)
  end
end
